reading.title: The Vet Clinic: Short Description
reading.text: A veterinarian has appointments for a dog, cat and rabbit. A hamster and guinea pig wait in secure carriers. Other appointments include a parrot, turtle, fish, snake and ferret. The vet uses a stethoscope to listen and a thermometer to check temperature. A scale measures weight. An otoscope helps examine an ear. The vet explains an X ray to the owner.

reading.title: The Vet Clinic: Mini Dialogue
reading.text: The vet explains an ultrasound and blood test. In the lab, staff use a microscope. A syringe and bandage are clinical supplies, not tools for the owner to use. The owner asks about vaccination, surgery and dental cleaning. They also discuss a microchip and whether to spay or neuter the animal. After treatment, prescribed medication may be needed. Staff check stitches, a cast or cone collar when relevant.
